author: ojiudezue
title: v5.108.9 shipped: Simpler forms: collapsed Advanced sections and plain-language text
summary: Simpler forms: collapsed Advanced sections and plain-language text
why: HA forces Advanced mode on and removes it in 2027.6, so every tuning field already showed on every form; the operator found the coordinator forms, especially Presence, hard to use. Collapsed sections hide rare tuning, and plain one-line text checked against the code tells the operator what each setting does. Save integrity was the risk, so Tier 2-DB with three reviews and mutation drills.
implications: Shipped FORM-TEXT-PLAIN-PASS-1, PRESENCE-GEOFENCE-FIELD-DEAD-1, CLIMATE-BACKSTOP-SECTION-CLEAR-ON-ABSENT-1 at v5.108.9; card(s) sit shipped_organic pending validation. Acceptance in README_v5.108.9.md (Live criteria).
revisit_trigger: Release 2 (visible= conditional fields + hacs.json floor) when a pytest-homeassistant-custom-component release pins HA 2026.11; energy wording pass.

refs.release_notes: Advanced mode (forced on since HA 2026.10, removed 2027.6) replaced by collapsed Advanced sections on 16 steps; operator-signed plain labels and descriptions (41 raw-key fields fixed, 8 wrong descriptions corrected); unused Presence geofence field removed; people added after startup are followed (never counted as an arrival); climate backstop holds no longer dropped on a save without opening that section.
